name: NutriTrace
description: Nutrition and diet tracker with barcode scanning, wearable integrations (Fitbit, Withings, Garmin, Health Connect), adaptive calorie goals, multi-user sharing, and a built-in AI assistant (alternative to MyFitnessPal, Cronometer). ([Source Code](https://github.com/TraceApps/nutritrace)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker`
